title: multi-horizon-queue-reshaper: dynamic deadline bands and KV warmup smoothing
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Introduce Multi-Horizon Queue Reshaper: dynamic deadline bands, per-tenant slot aging, and KV warmup smoothing to reduce starvation and tail latency for continuous batching workloads.
description: Motivation: Continuous batching previously used a single deadline window and a simple aging mechanism which led to starvation of small, latency-sensitive requests behind KV-heavy long-running batches in mixed workloads. This PR introduces the Multi-Horizon Queue Reshaper: a scheduler component that maintains multiple deadline bands (hot/warm/cold) and a lightweight reshaping step that shifts requests across bands based on observed waiting time, estimated token cost, and KV-pin pressure. The reshaper also drives a KV warmup smoother that pro-actively warms small-slot KV pins for cohorts likely to be served soon, reducing cold-KV latency spikes. Changes include: 1) new scheduler component scheduler/reshaper.go that implements multi-horizon bands and periodic reshaping pass; 2) per-tenant slot-aging state to avoid long-lived reservations starving high-priority short requests; 3) kv/kv_warmup_smoother.go which tracks recent KV access patterns and issues soft prefetch hints; 4) a new config surface to tune band windows and reshaping frequency; 5) added unit and integration tests plus e2e bench harness and docs. Commits: "initial reshaper skeleton and interfaces" introduces the reshaper plugin interface and metrics hooks; "implement banded deadline logic and slot-age bookkeeping" wires the reshaper into the continuous-batcher loop; "kv warmup smoother and integration tests" adds KV warmup heuristic and test coverage including synthetic mixed-workload scenarios. Testing/CI: unit tests and integration tests passed on the run after addressing a race in slot-age bookkeeping (race fixed in second commit). Perf: microbenchmarks on a 4-GPU staging cluster show 12-18% tail latency reduction (p99) for mixed KV-heavy + text-small workloads and up to 8% throughput improvement under 75th percentile latency SLOs. Rollout plan: feature gated behind a runtime flag default-disabled; gradual enable via canary on low-traffic tenants, then cohort expansion with rollout monitoring dashboards. Backwards compatibility: config defaults preserve prior behavior when disabled. Documentation: add docs/queue-reshaper.md with design and tuning guidance. Follow-ups: 1) add adaptive reshaping frequency derived from batch fullness signals (ENG-4879); 2) expose KV warmup metrics in console to correlate cold-KV incidents (ENG-4821).
commits_summary: 3 commits: (1) reshaper interface, metrics and test harness; (2) banded deadline implementation with slot-age bookkeeping and scheduler integration; (3) KV warmup smoother, config and tests; all commits signed and DCO compliant.
review_comments: Carlos Vega (review): Nice design; please add a short comment explaining why we pick three bands instead of a continuous score — we should also document the expected cost of the reshaping pass under heavy load.
Priya Menon (author): Added inline comments and a benchmark for reshaper CPU overhead in scheduler/reshaper_test.go, showed <1% CPU cost at 10k req/s in staging.
Marta Ivanova (review): Found a potential race on slot-age map when a slot is reclaimed and immediately reallocated — requested locking or swap semantics.
Priya Menon (author): Fixed by switching to a copy-on-write slot-age snapshot during reshaping; included test that previously flaked on race detector.
Darren Chu (review/approval): Verified perf numbers and integration tests locally; approved pending CI green.
CI System: Unit+Integration tests passed after rerun. E2E perf bench completed and attached in perf/benchmarks.
